description: Pick up a disposable cup and place it into a drop zone.

atomic_actions.label: approach_and_acquire_cup
atomic_actions.instruction: Approach and acquire the disposable cup with the grippers.

atomic_actions.label: transport_cup_to_box
atomic_actions.instruction: Transport the acquired disposable cup to the box.

atomic_actions.label: place_and_release_cup_in_drop_zone
atomic_actions.instruction: Place and release the disposable cup in the box drop zone.

atomic_actions.label: retreat_from_drop_zone
atomic_actions.instruction: Retreat the grippers from the box drop zone.
